data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: always-on hooks (check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity, check-plugin-self-ref, pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check) are NOT modified — verified via test
- DD5: canonical list of gating hooks vs always-on hooks documented in commit-workflow-validation.md and enforced by tests
- DD6 (closeout): audit criterion A — no enforcement bypass
- DD7 (closeout): audit criterion B — no unnecessary friction
- DD8: standard review/remediation cycle reports zero important findings against audit criteria A and B

## Description
Add a new test `tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh` that asserts plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md contains:
- All 6 always-on hooks named in the canonical list (check-portability, check-shim-refs, check-contract-schemas, check-referential-integrity, check-plugin-self-ref, pre-commit-enforcement-boundary-check)
- All 3 gated hooks named (pre-commit-test-gate, pre-commit-review-gate, pre-commit-test-quality-gate)
- The "network partition" caveat
- A "Always-On vs Gated Hooks" section header

The test is RED-first: it must fail when run before Task 1's documentation work has the canonical list.

Also: ensure test is executable (`chmod +x`); add `.test-index` entry mapping `commit-workflow-validation.md` → the test path; verify with check-test-index-duplicates.sh.

This task closes out audit criteria A and B by locking the documented invariants in place.

## File Impact
- tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh (create)
- .test-index (modify — add mapping)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New canonical-list test passes
  Verify: bash tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh
- [ ] New test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/docs/test-commit-workflow-validation-canonical-list.sh
- [ ] .test-index has mapping for commit-workflow-validation.md
  Verify: grep -q 'commit-workflow-validation.md' .test-index
- [ ] No duplicate entries in .test-index
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-test-index-duplicates.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
data.title: Document canonical hook list and lock with test (audit closeout)
